description:
View recent webhook delivery history. Shows which events were delivered, HTTP status codes, and timing.

Pass agent_id to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level. The hours time filter is supported only for project-level history.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to see deliveries for that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level.

hours.description: Project-level history only: include deliveries from the last N hours. Cannot be combined with agent_id. If omitted, deliveries are returned regardless of age.

limit.description: How many of the most recent deliveries to return. If omitted, the 20 most recent are returned.

name: list_webhook_deliveries

outputSchema.description: A page of webhook delivery history.

channel.description: Channel the event came from, or null.

createdAt.description: When the delivery record was created (ISO 8601).

eventType.description: Event type that was delivered, or null.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status your endpoint returned, or null.

lastAttemptAt.description: Time of the last attempt (ISO 8601), or null.

messageId.description: Message this delivery belongs to, or null.

nextRetryAt.description: Time of the next retry (ISO 8601), or null.

responseBody.description: Body your endpoint returned, or null.

hasMore.description: Whether more results exist beyond this page.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: List Webhook Deliveries
